text:
Maya: quick heads-up — noticed a perf regression in kernel-picker on canary when KV-prefetch is enabled under synthetic prefix-scan traffic. tail p99 spikes, and hit rate looks normal though. logs attached? :eyes:
Sam: yeah saw that too this morning on nightly. p50 unchanged, but p99 +120ms. suspect kernel choice for small batch dims (1x1024) switching to a generic matmul kernel.
Jorge: can you paste the perf profile / kernel-picker logs or an nvprof snippet? we need concrete numbers.
Maya: pasted below. also tiny repro command to run locally: 
```
./run_bench --harness replay --trace traces/prefix_scan_100k.json --fill-cache=prefix --concurrency=48 --kernel-cfg=auto --seed=42
```
Maya: sample kernel-picker excerpt from the canary run:
```
[INFO] kernel-picker: selected=mm_tiled_v2 for shape=(1,1024), latency_est=1.8ms, fallback=mm_generic
[DEBUG] perf: p99=180ms, gpu_util=68%, batch_queue=avg_len=4
```
Luca: interesting — mm_tiled_v2 was changed in the microkernel refactor last week. it helps longer sequences but might regress for small batch dims.
Priya: propose test matrix so we get apples-to-apples comparisons:
- replay traces vs synthetic uniform workloads
- cold cache (no warmup) vs prefix-warmup (preload KV)
- concurrency sweep: 8,16,32,48,96
- kernel mode: force mm_tiled_v2, force mm_generic, auto (picker)
Sam: agree. add deterministic seeds and pin model artifact + quantization to avoid variance. also capture driver/cuda versions in metadata.
Maya: and we need system-level constraints: same GPU instance type, same kernel lib versions, isolate host noise (no other pods), same traffic interarrival pattern for comparisons.
Jorge: add metrics to collect: kv_hit_rate over time, eviction_rate, avg_kv_latency, kernel_selection_histogram, gpu_utilization, queue_depth. dashboard will have heatmaps for p50/p95/p99 vs concurrency.
Maya: quick smoke numbers from a 1k-request synthetic run (cold vs warm cache):
```
cold:
p50=22ms p95=95ms p99=180ms kv_hit=4%
warm:
p50=18ms p95=40ms p99=45ms kv_hit=76%
```
Luca: that p99 drop on warm cache is huge — suggests eviction thrashing during the run or poor prefetching strategy for the scan pattern.
Sam: we should also run microbench forcing kernels at op-level to measure raw matmul latency: e.g.
```
python microbench_kernel.py --kernel mm_tiled_v2 --shape 1,1024 --iters 10000 --warmup 200
```
Sam: collect distribution of op latencies and compare to what the picker estimates.
Maya: plan of attack:
1) run full matrix (replay + synthetic) on perf cluster with artifacts uploaded
2) microbench per-kernel op-level comparison
3) try eviction policy tweak (increase LRU window / change prefetch stride) and re-run
4) open PR with kernel-picker telemetry to add selection reason in logs
Jorge: I'll add the metrics and a Grafana dashboard template. I'll also add a short TTLed Prometheus job for the perf runs.
Maya: I'll create a CI bench job named "eng-runtime/kv-scanbench-v2" and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/kv-sweep/1965432100. please include raw traces and kernel-picker logs.
Priya: owners: @Luca microkernel tests, @Sam cluster matrix, @Jorge metrics+dash, I'll create the CI job and coordinate runner capacity.
Luca: taking microkernel tests, will start tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: scheduled bench job created: job id 98765, queued on perf runners (eta ~15m).
Maya: thanks all :+1: let's sync tomorrow 11am PT if we have results or any blocker.
